transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. I want to get Tuesday's webhook incident postmortem moving. As a reminder, the initial investigation points to the queue-worker deployment as the immediate trigger, and we've confirmed no permanent loss of webhook payloads. Before I can sign the final postmortem remediation register and assign follow-up work, our policy requires the backend, SRE, security, and support owners to each give a final status. Can I get updates from each of those areas?
